notes.zh: 官方 GitHub release v1.2.0 正文明确点名 gradio demo（huggingface.co/spaces/hpcai-tech/open-sora），属一手发布证据。发布日取该 release 的 published 日期（2024-06-18）。核验方式：huggingface.co 主站本地不可达，demo 经官方 hf.space 直连验证 200、config 确认 space_id 为 hpcai-tech/open-sora 且 auth_required: false；Space 卡片原文经镜像读取失败（返回鉴权错误），故许可记 link-only，不声称开源。仓库代码 LICENSE 经 raw 原文核验为 Apache-2.0，仅作补充事实。本站未实测。
notes.en: The official GitHub release v1.2.0 body explicitly names the gradio demo (huggingface.co/spaces/hpcai-tech/open-sora) — first-party release evidence. Release date is the release's published date (2024-06-18). Verification: huggingface.co unreachable locally; the demo returned 200 via the official hf.space domain, config confirms space_id hpcai-tech/open-sora and auth_required false. The Space card could not be read via mirror (auth error), so license is recorded as link-only with no open-source claim. The repo code LICENSE was verified as Apache-2.0 from the raw file, noted only as a supplementary fact. Not run by this site.
